steps.content: Tonight, Euphoria is unusually quiet. Deep in the cabins, the lights are out. The air in the corridors is cold and damp, as if time itself has stopped.
Milly walks barefoot across the metal deck, her steps so light they're nearly soundless, yet slow, as if her feet were cast in lead.
She has no direction, no destination. Like an empty doll, she wanders through the silence, until her feet carry her to the door of the detention room.
This is Euphoria's darkest pit, yet she approaches it like returning to a nest she'd never left. Through the door's crack seeps the scent of old wood and a quiet that shuts out the world.

She pushes the door open, and darkness rushes to meet her as she steps inside. Milly knows this place like the back of her hand. She could find that table with her eyes closed. The one stained with her blood; the one that once held the photograph of her beloved.
She opens the drawer, takes out the photo, and lights a candle.
[Insert CG: Too Grieved to Speak]
Only a small stub of wax remains. Its flame is weak; a single breath could snuff it out. The trembling halo of light barely illuminates the faded figure in the yellowed photograph.
It occurs to her that it has been a long, long time since she last saw ${PlayerName}. She wonders if she would even remember his face if she didn't look at this picture every day.
steps.female_content: It occurs to her that it has been a long, long time since she last saw ${PlayerName}. She wonders if she would even remember her face if she didn't look at this picture every day.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: What you love is nothing more than a fantasy. You love the fairy tale where you're saved, and the idea of yourself, waiting faithfully for your savior. The person you confide in, the person you adore... it's always been a delusion living in your head. And here you need to help me elope, just to prove your "true love conquers all" bullshit?

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: We've fallen this far, and you think you can just plug your ears, shut your eyes, and find happiness by believing in love? Well, good for you. Go on, keep it up!

Tonight, the portholes are pitch black, clogged, sealed. No moonlight shines through. The trembling candle flame slowly burns through the wick until it, along with the light in her eyes, flickers and dies.
Then, she hears a frail voice.

steps.speaker: Figure in Shadow
steps.content: You poor thing. So much misery, yet you still shed no tears.
Milly doesn't turn around. Another hand, slender and covered in scars, reaches out from the shadows, passing over her shoulder to rest gently on the photograph.
With it comes a strange fragrance. A familiar perfume. Mr. E? Or one of his guests? Milly doesn't remember.
She doesn't care. Silently, she brushes the hand away from the photo. A soft laugh comes from behind.

steps.speaker: Figure in Shadow
steps.content: I know you've always loved him. That's what I liked about you from the start. And why I brought you aboard.
steps.female_content: I know you've always loved her. That's what I liked about you from the start. And why I brought you aboard.

steps.speaker: Figure in Shadow
steps.content: Your friend was too harsh... There's nothing wrong with loving someone. Love doesn't have to mean losing yourself or getting hurt. Everything you've done has been for your own happiness.

steps.speaker: Figure in Shadow
steps.content: If he makes you happy, isn't it only natural to want his attention? To want him? To possess him, and make him fulfill your desires? You know exactly what you want, and you never give up. How admirable.
steps.female_content: If she makes you happy, isn't it only natural to want her attention? To want her? To possess her, and make her fulfill your desires? You know exactly what you want, and you never give up. How admirable.

steps.speaker: Figure in Shadow
steps.content: You're helping Sallie for your own sake, aren't you?

The person wraps her arms around Milly gently, whispering in her ear. The voice, like the fragrance, feels comforting, beguiling. She seems to know how innocent, how easily deceived this girl is. And so she speaks without restraint.

steps.speaker: Figure in Shadow
steps.content: If she gets out, she can send a message to him. Your <color=#fb9259>beloved</color> will know what a great person you are. He will come to save you. And when he does, you'll have a thousand ways to make him love you, make him forever yours. You know you have that power.
steps.female_content: If she gets out, she can send a message to her. Your <color=#fb9259>beloved</color> will know what a great person you are. She will come to save you. And when she does, you'll have a thousand ways to make her love you, make her forever yours. You know you have that power.

steps.speaker: Figure in Shadow
steps.content: Unfortunately, we're out of time.
This finally gets a response. Milly sits up straight and turns to face the figure in the shadows.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: ...What do you mean?

steps.speaker: Figure in Shadow
steps.content: We've been discovered. This paradise of ours will soon be destroyed.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Can't we escape?

steps.speaker: Figure in Shadow
steps.content: Of course. There's still time.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Then...

steps.speaker: Figure in Shadow
steps.content: Have you forgotten what Mr. E said? He said...
She whispers the words into Milly's ear. Milly's eyes go wide. Her reaction pleases the woman, yet also moves her to pity. She rises slightly and cups Milly's vacant face in her hands.

steps.speaker: Figure in Shadow
steps.content: It's alright. You have me. I'm quite fond of you, and I'm willing to take you away, to fulfill your wishes, to bring you to your beloved... I can give you so much more.

steps.speaker: Figure in Shadow
steps.content: Show me how strong your love is. Prove to me it can be your strength. I believe you can. Because you saw the truth a long time ago...

steps.speaker: Figure in Shadow
steps.content: Death has shrouded everything. Love is the only light.

The strange fragrance turns into smoke, weaving into threads that coil around Milly's limbs. It is a familiar, gentle sensation, the same one she felt every time she passed out under the gangsters' fists or Mr. E's blade, every time she suffocated in this room. It is the breath of death.
She lets death hold her, her eyes staring blankly into the endless darkness. After a long moment, Milly smiles again. As if what awaits in the abyss is not fear or emptiness.
...but her light.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Yes... Death has shrouded everything. Love... is the only light.

Evelleon covers Milly's eyes. A twisted crimson pattern blooms across her back, blood seeping from the sign, thickening into honey, falling from the void into Milly's palm. It fuses with her flesh, turning into a bee-shaped ornament.
A form most fitting for Milly. The Sage of the Underground smiles with satisfaction. She removes her hand.
The light fades, returning everything to tranquil darkness.
